topic.title: Business: What Comes Next in Small Business Resilience Plans

candidate_instructions: Read all five sections. Answer Questions 1-5. Follow the stated word limits exactly.

sections.heading: The Beginning
sections.text: The program plans to expand membership to fifty businesses. New training modules in digital marketing will be offered. Micro-loans will be arranged for qualified members. Partnerships with banks will improve access to credit. The program will expand to three other communities.

sections.heading: How It Works
sections.text: Technology will help more. People can use computers and phones. It will be easier to join..

sections.heading: People's Stories
sections.text: We will work with more organizations. Schools will help. Businesses will help. Everyone will help..

sections.heading: Good and Bad
sections.text: We will find more money. The government might help. Rich people might give money. Companies might help..

sections.heading: The Future
sections.text: One day, every community will have a project like this. Everyone will be happier. The world will be better..

passage.full_text:
Paragraph 1 — The Beginning
The program plans to expand membership to fifty businesses. New training modules in digital marketing will be offered. Micro-loans will be arranged for qualified members. Partnerships with banks will improve access to credit. The program will expand to three other communities.

Paragraph 2 — How It Works
Technology will help more. People can use computers and phones. It will be easier to join..

Paragraph 3 — People's Stories
We will work with more organizations. Schools will help. Businesses will help. Everyone will help..

Paragraph 4 — Good and Bad
We will find more money. The government might help. Rich people might give money. Companies might help..

Paragraph 5 — The Future
One day, every community will have a project like this. Everyone will be happier. The world will be better..
